as_told.title: Gimbal eyewitness accounts match the reconstructed trajectory

plain: The object in the Gimbal video, a 2015 US Navy infrared recording made by a fighter jet off Florida, is said to make a vertical U-turn, a J-hook path that matches what the aircrew say the object tracked on their radar did. A guest named Marik von Rennenkampff makes this case to Michels in a debate with the skeptic Mick West, describing it as a "spectacular match" with the eyewitness accounts of an object reversing direction "with no radius of turn". If true, it would mean the video and the radar point to the same impossible manoeuvre.
